NUMBER  defs    5,0
PRINTHL push    hl
        push    de
        ld      a,h
        srl     a
        srl     a
        srl     a
        srl     a
        call    TRANS
        ld      (NUMBER),a
        ld      a,h
        and     #0F
        call    TRANS
        ld      (NUMBER+1),a
        ld      a,l
        srl     a
        srl     a
        srl     a
        srl     a
        call    TRANS
        ld      (NUMBER+2),a
        ld      a,l
        and     #0F
        call    TRANS
        ld      (NUMBER+3),a
        ld      de,#5040
        ld      hl,NUMBER
        call    PTEXT1
        pop     de
        pop     hl
        ret
TRANS   add     a,48
        cp      58
        ret     c
        add     a,7
